messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: paging: elevated TLS handshake errors on prod-gateway cluster — spike in 5xx/timeouts detected across multiple edge nodes

alice: ack. i'm oncall and seeing the 5xx spike. starting triage.

raj: i'm available, will look at rotator and cert store.

alice: quick dig — logs show repeated x509 expiration errors from several edges

alice: logs paste:
```
2026-03-15T10:15:02Z edge-1 tls.go:256: handshake error: x509: certificate has expired
2026-03-15T10:15:14Z edge-3 tls.go:256: handshake error: x509: certificate has expired
2026-03-15T10:15:30Z edge-9 tls.go:256: handshake error: x509: certificate has expired
```

maria: we rotated intermediates last week via rotator-service — wonder if reload failed.

raj: running openssl check against prod-gateway-1
```
$ openssl s_client -connect prod-gateway-1.redwood.internal:443 -servername prod-gateway
# certificate chain shows leaf Expires: 2027 but issuer 'Intermediate CA' Not After: Mar 14 09:00:00 2026 GMT
```

alice: so the proxy is still serving the old intermediate which expired. rotator thinks it uploaded the new one. possible reload/caching issue.

sre_lead: can we confirm whether the rotator requested a proxy reload and whether that succeeded? also check control-plane connectivity at time of reload.

ops_rotator: checking rotator logs now — here's relevant excerpt:
```
2026-03-14T22:02:58Z rotator INFO begin upload intermediate-v2.pem to s3://cert-bucket/prod/intermediates/
2026-03-14T22:03:00Z rotator INFO uploaded intermediate-v2.pem (sha256:abcd...)
2026-03-14T22:03:05Z rotator INFO dispatching reload to edge-group 'prod'
2026-03-14T22:03:07Z rotator WARN reload failed for group prod: control-plane timeout (504)
2026-03-14T22:03:09Z rotator INFO will retry reload in 30s (retry_count=1)
2026-03-14T22:03:39Z rotator WARN retry reload failed: control-plane still unreachable
```

alice: reload failed. proxies never picked up intermediate-v2 -> they're still using the expired chain. that explains client handshake failures.

maria: mitigation options: (A) force rolling restart of edge-proxy pool so hot files are reloaded, (B) enable fallback to allow-stale-intermediate (reduces failures but is a security policy change), or (C) re-trigger reload via control-plane after fixing connectivity.

raj: don't flip fallback flags mid-incident. option A is fastest with acceptable risk — phased restart to avoid full disruption.

alice: starting canary: restarting edge-1 only. command: 
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy -n prod --selector=edge=edge-1
```

oncall-bot: annotation: canary restart started by alice at 2026-03-15T10:22:00Z

alice: canary results: edge-1 restarted and now serves intermediate-v2; handshake errors on that host dropped to baseline (0.1%).

raj: scheduling phased rollout. will limit maxUnavailable=2 and throttle at 30s between restarts. queuing with deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: rolling restart queued for 12 nodes (maxUnavailable=2, delay=30s).

alice: monitoring metrics: total 5xx rate falling from 6.3% -> 0.4% as restarts progress.

support_bot: customer-impact summary: approx 1.6% of connections experienced 5xx during 2026-03-14T22:00:00Z -> 2026-03-15T10:22:00Z window. top impacted customers: Acme Inc, BetaCo. CS notified and incident page posted.

maria: control-plane telemetry shows an intermittent outage at 2026-03-14T22:03:06Z that affected reloads. we need follow-up with infra.

sre_lead: agreed. root cause hypothesis: rotator uploaded new intermediate but control-plane timeout prevented reload, proxies continued serving expired chain. contributing factor: lack of alert for "cert uploaded but reload failed" and proxies requiring restart to pick up chain.

raj: action items (assigned):
- raj: open ticket to add retry/backoff + stronger alerting in rotator for reload failures.
- maria: investigate control-plane timeout and add autoscaling/failover for reload API.
- alice: prototype proxy hot-reload for chain without restart (experimental branch exists).
- ops_rotator: add verification step post-upload to validate chain presented by a representative proxy.

alice: handing off; i'll stay on for 15m to watch metrics then hand to raj for follow-ups. :thumbsup:

raj: taking post-incident ownership. will file the follow-up, schedule a short retro, and draft status update for customers.

oncall-bot: incident mitigated — status set to 'mitigated' at 2026-03-15T10:41:00Z

sre_lead: thanks team. will review retro items and reopen if regressions show up.

maria: note for postmortem: include timeline of rotator upload -> reload attempt -> control-plane error -> phased restart mitigation.

support_bot: final customer note queued for 11:00 PDT, will mention impact window and remediation steps.
